notes_for_editor: Only the 2014 extant list and two elevation records were found. Two searches found no build date, builder, staffing or access information. Elevation conflict: tnlandforms gives 1743 ft (the record's 531.3 m matches it); TopoQuest gives 1712 ft MSL from the USGS Clinton quad. A YouTube page title calls the site Walden's Ridge Fire Tower; the title alone is not a sourced name, so the story does not use it. Status is not checked for 2026. Access is unknown and no visit information is recorded.
